name: Two Fronts Plaza at Chili and Paul
summary: Two Fronts Plaza at Chili and Paul is a neighborhood shopping center located at a prominent intersection on Chili Avenue in western Rochester. With extended daily hours and a strong 4.4-star rating, it serves as a convenient retail destination for local residents.
demographics: Two Fronts Plaza serves the western Rochester suburban market, primarily attracting middle-income families and working professionals from the Chili and Gates neighborhoods. The trade area consists of established residential communities with a mix of homeowners and renters, typically ranging from young families to middle-aged households. Shoppers in this area tend to prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday goods and services within a quick drive from home. The center draws from a blue-collar to middle-class demographic base characteristic of Rochester's western suburbs.
description: Two Fronts Plaza at Chili and Paul is a neighborhood shopping center strategically located at 3240 Chili Avenue in Rochester, New York. Situated at the intersection of Chili Avenue and Paul Road, this plaza serves as a convenient retail destination for residents of western Rochester and the surrounding Chili community. The center maintains extended operating hours from 9:00 AM to 10:30 PM, accommodating the busy schedules of local shoppers and commuters. With a solid 4.4-star rating from nearly 500 Google reviews, Two Fronts Plaza has established itself as a reliable neighborhood shopping option. The plaza's accessible location along a major thoroughfare makes it an easy stop for everyday shopping needs and services in the Rochester area.
